# make.ge - Comprehensive Automation & AI Agent Knowledge Base

## Course Overview
- **Title:** AI Assistants, Agents and No-Code Automation (AI ასისტენტები, აგენტები და No-Code ავტომატიზაცია)
- **Institution:** Smart Academy (Tbilisi, Georgia)
- **Instructor:** Giorgi Basilaia (Associate Professor, [Free University of Tbilisi](https://freeuni.edu.ge/ge/details/?person=giorgi-basilaia))
- **Format:** 7 Sessions (20 hours total) - five 3-hour sessions + two 2.5-hour sessions; 6 Online sessions + 1 In-person session
- **Target Audience:** Business owners, operational managers, digital marketers, IT specialists, and professionals seeking to automate repetitive tasks without programming.

## Session-by-Session Curriculum

### Session 1 (3 hours): AI Foundations, Local LLMs & First Automation
- Assistant vs agent and stateful vs stateless interaction.
- Creating a custom assistant and a first Make.com workflow.
- Core Local LLM lab with Ollama/LM Studio, offline testing, hardware constraints, and privacy checks.

### Session 2 (3 hours): Make.com, Data Structures, Webhooks & APIs
- JSON, arrays, iterators, aggregators, triggers, actions, filters, and routers.
- Google Sheets, webhooks, HTTP requests, external APIs, debugging, and coding-assistant support.

### Session 3 (3 hours): Knowledge Bases, RAG, MCP & AI Agents
- Structured outputs, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, and RAG evaluation.
- Memory, tools, function calling, ReAct, self-correction, multi-agent concepts, and MCP fundamentals.

### Session 4 (3 hours): n8n, Production Patterns & Computer Use
- n8n self-hosting, expressions, JavaScript nodes, data stores, retries, logging, and monitoring.
- Core Computer Use module: visual actions, API-first design, legacy-system automation, prompt-injection risk, and safe approvals.

### Session 5 (3 hours): B2B Automation, Security & ROI
- 35-minute Lovable support portal case: responsive UI, Make webhook, AI triage, structured status states, and human approval.
- Deterministic vs reasoning workflows, support and document-processing case studies.
- Human-in-the-Loop, PII/GDPR controls, audit trails, cost optimization, and ROI.

### Session 6 (2.5 hours): Claude Agent SDK, MCP & Agent Trust
- Core Claude Agent SDK module: agent loop, tools, hooks, permissions, checkpoints, and background workers.
- Grok Bot vs Grok API distinction, followed by a Grok API + X Search live build using date/account filters, cited sources, structured JSON, and human review.
- MCP registries, context engineering, credentials, approvals, audit trails, and vertical agents.

### Session 7 (2.5 hours): Production Agent Masterclass & Capstone
- 60-minute integration masterclass combining Local LLM, Claude Agent SDK, and Computer Use in one governed architecture.
- 90-minute capstone block: eight 5-minute demos with 2-minute Q&A, peer voting, mentor feedback, awards, and certification.
- Trend analysis and career material remain available as an asynchronous bonus module.
